title: release.sh installs before the running-app check
notes:
scripts/release.sh:109 runs pnpm install --frozen-lockfile before it calls scripts/rebuild.sh, which now checks for an app running out of the checkout before its own install. With pnpm start running out of the main checkout and a dependency change on main (an Electron bump, say), release.sh rewrites node_modules/electron under the running dev app, and only then does rebuild.sh stop. Fix: run node scripts/no-running-app.mjs before release.sh's install.

Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/332
Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/331#discussion_r4613442189
